sentences.text: Ragtime is a 1981 American drama film , directed by Miloš Forman , based on 1975 historical novel Ragtime by E. L. Doctorow .	Miloš Forman	Miloš Forman	Ragtime	Ragtime (novel)	E. L. Doctorow	E. L. Doctorow	historical novel	historical novel

The action takes place in and around New York City , New Rochelle , and Atlantic City early in the 1900s , including fictionalized references to actual people and events of the time .	New York City	New York City	New Rochelle	New Rochelle, New York	Atlantic City	Atlantic City, New Jersey	the 1900s	1900s (decade)

The film features the final film appearances of James Cagney and Pat O'Brien ; early appearances , in small parts , by Samuel L. Jackson , Jeff Daniels , Fran Drescher , Ethan Phillips and John Ratzenberger ; and an uncredited appearance from Jack Nicholson .	James Cagney	James Cagney	Pat O'Brien	Pat O'Brien (actor)	Samuel L. Jackson	Samuel L. Jackson	Jeff Daniels	Jeff Daniels	Fran Drescher	Fran Drescher	Ethan Phillips	Ethan Phillips	John Ratzenberger	John Ratzenberger	Jack Nicholson	Jack Nicholson
The music score was composed by Randy Newman .	Randy Newman	Randy Newman
The film was nominated for eight Oscars .	Oscars	Academy Awards
